summary: East kerb against bush on a quiet street, homes over 30 m away.
reasons: Bush and university land behind east kerb

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the east; construction buildings 17 m away across the road and the nearest home 33 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a dirt strip on the east edge and cars parked beside it in the Esri image, so a van can pull in.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street serving the university and a few homes; local traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars parked at the east edge near 90 m. Three No Stopping Any Time signs sit at the south end, within about 25 m of the start, not at this section.
